title: Account and agreement requests
notice: Submit a request for private review. Your data, access and contracts do not change when you submit it.

scopes.studio_deletion: Request removal of eligible Studio data. Shared sign-in, Store purchases, financial records and legal evidence require separate handling.
scopes.contract_termination: Request a review of your agreement's termination terms. Submitting or approving this request does not end the agreement.
scopes.onboarding_reset: Request a recoverable restart of artist onboarding. Existing recordings, uploads, signed documents and audit history are not deleted automatically.

confirm: I understand this is a review request, not immediate deletion or termination.
error: The request could not be saved. Check your connection and whether an open request already exists.
unavailable: Account requests could not be loaded. No data has been changed.
